findings.message: The readiness guard rejects DaemonSets with desired scheduled pods but none ready. For five desired pods and zero ready pods, this function returns an error instead of the required replica count of five. Restore the DesiredNumberScheduled zero guard.
findings.evidence: Lines 151–152 check ds.Status.NumberReady == 0 and return an error. The supplied contract requires counting desired scheduled pods even when none are ready.

findings.message: When some pods are ready, the function still returns the wrong replica count whenever readiness differs from desired scheduling. For five desired pods and two ready pods, it returns two instead of five. Return DesiredNumberScheduled.
findings.evidence: Line 154 returns int(ds.Status.NumberReady); the diff replaces int(ds.Status.DesiredNumberScheduled). This violates the supplied replica-count contract independently of the zero-ready error.
